pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "xberg.h"

int main(void) {
    FILE *pdf_bytes_file = fopen("pdf/sample_contract.pdf", "rb");
    if (pdf_bytes_file == NULL) return EXIT_FAILURE;
    fseek(pdf_bytes_file, 0, SEEK_END);
    long pdf_bytes_size = ftell(pdf_bytes_file);
    if (pdf_bytes_size < 0) { fclose(pdf_bytes_file); return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    rewind(pdf_bytes_file);
    uint8_t *pdf_bytes_buf = malloc(pdf_bytes_size > 0 ? (size_t)pdf_bytes_size : 1);
    if (pdf_bytes_buf == NULL) { fclose(pdf_bytes_file); return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    if (fread(pdf_bytes_buf, 1, (size_t)pdf_bytes_size, pdf_bytes_file) != (size_t)pdf_bytes_size) { free(pdf_bytes_buf); fclose(pdf_bytes_file); return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    fclose(pdf_bytes_file);
    uintptr_t result = xberg_pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes_buf, (uintptr_t)pdf_bytes_size, NULL);
    free(pdf_bytes_buf);
    (void)result;
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
